scenes.text: Build multiplication facts from known facts. For example, 6 times 7 equals 5 times 7 plus 7, so 35 plus 7 equals 42.
Use the known fact 8 times 5 equals 40 to find 9 times 5. The answer is 45. Add one group of 5: 40 plus 5 equals 45.
A learner during a library project knows 4 times 5 equals 20. How can they calculate 5 times 5 using one more group? Pause the video and think.
